issues.description: SQL query constructed by concatenating or interpolating user input, which may lead to SQL Injection.
issues.snippet: query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + username + "'"
issues.recommended_fix: Use parameterized queries or ORM parameter binding. Avoid building SQL with string concatenation or f-strings.

issues.description: Potential multi-line Command Injection. Shell or OS command constructed using potentially unsafe string concatenation or interpolation.
issues.recommended_fix: Use argument lists instead of shell=True; validate or sanitize inputs. Avoid concatenating user input into shell commands.

issues.description: User input is inserted into HTML without proper escaping, which can lead to XSS.
issues.recommended_fix: Escape or sanitize user-supplied data before inserting into HTML; use safe templating functions and Content Security Policy.

issues.description: Hardcoded secret or API key found in code or configuration.
issues.recommended_fix: Move secrets to secure storage (environment variables, secret manager). Remove keys from version control and rotate keys if they were committed.
